string-array.item: Contest ends last date of every month
Answer easy questions and be eligible to win prizes
Win Portable Hard drives and many more items

file.string: Note: Winners will be notified via this app as well as via email. Make sure you provide your correct email address.

The following details are OPTIONAL but will be required if you are declared a WINNER so that the prizes can be sent to you. Either you can enter them now, or later after you are declared a WINNER. These optional details can be provided later via the CONTEST REGISTRATION PAGE and then the UPDATE REGISTRATION DETAILS
Your details will be updated. Thank you
